in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: The law has been in effect since the 1970s.

result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, clause (b) bound only the lessor: "At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay any amount in excess of the following." St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55 (effective August 1, 2025 per § 136) extended it to an 'agent of the lessor' and to payments made to an agent. The original enactment date is not stated in the documents; a secondary source says only that the law has been in effect since the 1970s.
